messages.author: 49d86f7ce970cb8e
messages.subject: R Users In the Pub
parts:
A few of us have decided to get together to do an informal meetup to
discuss how we are using R, things we would like to learn about, and
whatever other topics flow forth after we have a few beers.

Since it seems like we are spread out all over the city, I'm proposing
Wednesday, September 29th at Ernie's on Banks in the Museum District
~6:30pm. They have an upstairs area where I believe we can reserve a
table. The only issue with the upstairs area is that it is NOT
handicap accessible. If there is anyone who is thinking of attending
that this might be an issue for please let me know so we can see about
a downstairs table or changing locations.

Once we get a somewhat firm attendance number, I'll call about
reserving a table.

Hopefully, this will be the start of what will become a more regular
and formalized meeting group down the road.

Regards,
Ed

was thinking of CoffeeGroundz over in midtown, but I'm open to
